mod.name: Load Absolute Opponent, Uninstall, Crash
mod.summary: When the Absolute Opponent gun pack is detected, it is moved to a trash folder and startup is aborted on purpose. Nothing is deleted, so it can always be restored.
banner: Do not load this mod together with Absolute Opponent
banner.en: 请勿同时加载此mod和绝对彼方
log.clean: Scanned {}: no Absolute Opponent artifacts found, continuing startup.
log.trash_history: {} historical batch(es) still sit in the trash folder, see RESTORE.txt to bring them back.
log.hit_count: {} Absolute Opponent artifact(s) detected, moving them to the trash folder:
log.moved: moved to trash: {} ({} file(s) / {} dir(s) / {} bytes, {} ms)
crash.description: Absolute Opponent gun pack detected (TaCZ namespace=ocle); it was moved to the trash folder and startup was aborted on purpose
crash.exception: {} artifact(s) moved to the trash folder: {}
crash.advice: Nothing was deleted. The files were only moved into the trash folder, content and timestamps unchanged.
crash.advice.tail: Empty the trash folder if you no longer need the pack; keeping both is only possible by removing this mod's jar.
restore.title: Absolute Opponent gun pack was moved to the trash folder (restorable)
restore.intro: Nothing here was deleted. These files were only moved out of their original location; content, size and timestamps are unchanged.
restore.steps:
How to restore:
1. Quit the game completely
2. Copy the listed file(s)/folder(s) from the current location back to the original location
3. If this mod stays installed, they will be moved aside again on the next launch
4. Back them up before restoring
restore.note: This mod and Absolute Opponent cannot coexist by design. To keep both, remove this mod's jar.
